items.markdown:
Adelaide’s top luxury real estate agencies include `WILLIAMS Real Estate, TOOP+TOOP, Turner Real Estate, and Ouwens Casserly` . These firms lead the prestige market through record-breaking high-end sales, specialized luxury marketing campaigns, and extensive private buyer databases.

### Top Prestige Property Agencies

- **[WILLIAMS Real Estate](https://www.williamsproperty.com.au/592041/stephanie-williams)** : Led by Stephanie and John Williams, this Rose Park-based agency dominates South Australia's luxury property sector. They achieve record-level median sale prices through a tailored, high-end strategy focusing on architecture, bespoke digital campaigns, and an exclusive private database of high-net-worth clients.[[1]](https://www.williamsproperty.com.au/592041/stephanie-williams)[[2]](https://www.realestate.com.au/agency/williams-real-estate-rla-247163-YIPRKX)
- **[TOOP+TOOP](https://www.toop.com.au/)** : Recognized as one of Adelaide's most innovative independent agencies, TOOP+TOOP excels in high-end residential sales. They use cutting-edge digital marketing, sophisticated media integration, and targeted auction strategies to showcase premium properties across Adelaide’s premier suburbs.[[1]](https://toop.com.au/1001-21-centenary-street-north-adelaide-5162488)[[2]](https://x.com/ToopandToop_)
- **[Turner Real Estate (Prestige Sales)](https://www.turnerrealestate.com.au/prestige-sales/)** : Turner offers a dedicated luxury property division backed by decades of local market experience. Their prestige team provides specialized advisory services for high-value family homes and modern architectural builds in elite inner-ring locations.[[1]](https://www.turnerrealestate.com.au/prestige-sales/)
- **[Ouwens Casserly](https://ocre.com.au/)** : As a major privately-owned agency group in South Australia, Ouwens Casserly handles substantial volume in the upper-mid to high-end residential market. They combine strong local neighborhood networks with professional branding to market high-value residential properties and developments.[[1]](https://ocre.com.au/offices/kensington)
